notes.central: Research cut short: shared WebSearch budget (200/turn) was exhausted partway through; remaining checks used WebFetch on known URLs only. Several county results PDFs (Osage, Maries, Hickory, Benton, Henry samples) are scanned images unreadable by the fetcher. Columbia's 1% public safety sales tax and Jefferson City's capital improvements sales tax extension were on the Aug 4, 2026 ballot, not Nov 3 (excluded). Morgan R-I's Nov 2025 63-cent levy (failed 236-498) is a prior attempt, excluded. Boone Prop L: sources differ on whether it is 3/8 cent new or raises existing 1/8 to 3/8; ballot text (BallotReady) says countywide 3/8-cent sales tax for law enforcement expiring 12/31/2042. Percentages computed from reported counts. All results unofficial election-night.
notes.east-northeast: Session-wide WebSearch limit (200) was hit mid-task, so several NE Missouri counties were not checked. St. Charles: official sample ballot lists only 6 local questions (all districts; no county or city measures); results from St. Charles County Election Authority ENR, all precincts. Jefferson: stltoday and STLPR list only Hillsboro Prop H and Meramec Valley Prop K; Jefferson County official results not reached. Franklin: county's Nov ballot issues document lists only Union Ambulance and Meramec Valley Prop K. Warren: Warren County Record results (26/26 precincts) show only statewide items. Washington, Marion, Audrain: official sample ballots/fair ballot language show only statewide items. St. Francois: official unofficial-results summary (21/21 precincts) shows only statewide items. Many local measures in these counties (property-tax freeze questions, ambulance/fire sales taxes, lodging taxes) were on the April 7, 2026 ballot, not November, and were excluded. STLPR's voter guide listed Meramec Valley Prop K under St. Charles County, but the district is in Franklin/Jefferson/St. Louis counties.
notes.kc-northwest: Results are election-night unofficial (as of roughly 9 p.m. Nov 3 to 12:30 a.m. Nov 4). KXCV and Cass give raw counts; Beacon and KPGZ give only percentages, so their yes_votes/no_votes are null. Some yes_pct values were calculated from counts, as noted per measure. Multi-county districts (Golden Age NHD, Big Creek, Cameron city and ambulance, Lee's Summit, Drexel) have partial-county results; check the notes before treating any as final. Kansas City itself had no city questions found for Nov 3 (its 2026 city questions were in April and August). Excluded: statewide Amendments 3/6/7/8, statewide Prop A, and judicial retention. An Excelsior Springs annexation article referred to a Nov. 4 election (2025), not 2026, so it was excluded. The shared WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn) ran out mid-task, leaving Holt, Worth, Mercer, Grundy, Livingston, Clinton, and Lafayette mostly unsearched.
notes.southeast: Strong 'none' evidence: Cape Girardeau, Scott and Howell, whose countywide sample ballot publications (Cape also its fair ballot language) list only statewide amendments and Prop A, plus candidate races. Howell's Nov. 3 returns also show no local questions. Weaker 'none' evidence: Shannon and Oregon (KY3 results page lists only candidate races there), Perry (Republic-Monitor's election coverage and the KFVS list show none; Prop KIDS was April/August), and Carter and Ripley (KWOC previews mention none). The KFVS results page (kfvs12.com/politics/election-results) is the main source of local tallies. It shows no precincts-reporting figure or call marker for local items, so only Poplar Bluff is marked passed (backed by a DAR headline); the rest are 'unknown' with leading tallies. The Pemiscot consolidation is a November re-vote: November tallies (157-38; 115-140) differ from August's (125-20; 113-122). Excluded as not on Nov. 3: West Plains sports-complex sales tax (failed Aug. 4), Perry County Prop KIDS (April fail, August pass), Jackson lodging tax (August), Oregon County April questions, Iron County April questions, East Carter R-II levy (August), Pilot Knob revenue bonds (August). semissourian.com, darnews.com and dddnews.com block fetching, so their Nov. 3 coverage could only be seen through search snippets. The WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn, shared) ran out mid-task, so Madison, Reynolds, Bollinger, Mississippi and New Madrid were not searched individually.
notes.southwest: Election-night unofficial results. Results were confirmed only for Greene (Springfield Q1-4 all failed, 59/59 precincts) and Stone (Indian Point sales tax failed 23.4%; PWSD No.1 dissolution passed 78.0%, 22/22 precincts). The KY3 results page (ky3.com/politics/election-results) was used to cross-check its list of tracked Missouri local questions, but it showed only placeholder zeros when fetched. KY3's list left out the Sarcoxie RFPD levy, so it is not exhaustive. Taney, Polk, Lawrence and McDonald posted results PDFs that are image-only and could not be read. The shared web-search budget ran out partway through, so later checks relied on direct page fetches. Barry results, Webster results, and the Newton and Laclede ballots are the main gaps. Hickory, Texas and Camden questions in the KY3 tracker are outside this region's county list and were left out.
notes.stl-city-county: St. Louis County list is taken from the county Board of Elections' official November 3, 2026 ballot content report (NovemberFIO.pdf). That report lists every local question in the county: 2 county, 6 municipal (Chesterfield A/Q, Creve Coeur G, Florissant A/B, Webster Groves Amendment 1), and 7 school (incl. multi-county Meramec Valley K). It says no fire, ambulance, library or other special-district questions were on the ballot, so the other ~80 municipalities (Kirkwood, University City, Clayton, Ballwin, etc.) had no questions. St. Louis City had two questions (Prop 1, Prop B), confirmed by Ballotpedia, the STLPR voter guide and Post-Dispatch results. A pre-ballot St. Louis American preview also mentioned a city 'charter modernization' question, but no final source lists it, so it is not included. Vote counts come from the St. Louis Post-Dispatch results pages (graphics.stltoday.com), which show 100% of precincts/polling places reporting (city 67/67, county 200/200). All results are unofficial. STLPR and St. Louis American stories match these numbers. The election boards' own results pages (stlelections.com, the stlouiscountymo.gov results PDF) could not be fetched. Prop 1 and Prop B in the city each needed 60% as charter amendments.
notes.results-4: Added from the results-4 upload (county clerk unofficial PDFs, KY3 and KFVS result pages, Southeast Missourian roundup). Partial-district tallies are labeled in each measure's note. Scanned PDFs were OCRed and spot-checked against the page images.
notes.factcheck: Nov 5 pass: every county results PDF used for local measures was checked against the app's Proposition A county totals where available (Jackson, Polk, Crawford, Taney matched exactly).
notes.audit: Nov 7 audit: every measure with vote counts was checked against its source (county clerk reports, election-authority results pages, or the news page cited). Three were corrected: Big Creek Ambulance District (Daviess portion had been counted twice), Weaubleau R-III (Benton portion had been added to a KY3 total that already covered the district), and Sarcoxie Rural Fire (replaced KOAM figure with the Jasper and Lawrence clerk totals).
